title: fr.clock.set arguments
description: Second `unix` (2000-2099) begins at node time `at_us` (0 = now): the node waits until then and writes the time in one burst, which restarts the chip's 1 Hz chain, and clears the oscillator-stop flag. INVALID_ARGS for a target more than 2 s ahead or 1 s behind, or a unix outside 2000-2099. It answers at once; the write follows, and `set` fires only when it succeeded (a hub waits for it).
